plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Trim SMH to 5% to lower semiconductor risk.
Sell QQQ and SMCI to cut exposure to weaker names.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a significant cash buffer.
Expect lower volatility and a more conservative growth profile.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on income and broad market exposure, aiming for low drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to small positions.
Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce semiconductor risk.
Sell QQQ to reduce broad index exposure.
Buy XLV as a defensive sector addition.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a defensive sector. It aims for risk-first growth with a moderate cash buffer.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% and SMH to 5% to manage concentration.
Sell QQQ to reduce broad index exposure.
Add to leveraged semiconductor ETFs SOXL and MUU.
Buy XLV for defensive sector exposure.
Buy AMZN as a high-potential tech addition.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration in strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-scoring setups, including leveraged ETFs. Expect higher potential upside but also significantly larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Increase QQQI to 30% for enhanced income focus.
Sell SMH and QQQ to remove speculative exposure.
Sell CRWD to cut high-beta single name risk.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.
Expect lower volatility and reliable income, but limited capital appreciation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI and reducing leverage and high-beta names. It aims for low drawdowns and consistent distributions, not significant capital growth.
